Consequence of U11: every packaged client's checkForUpdates() fails DNS resolution → GenericProvider throws (not 404, not ECONNREFUSED → no retry) → AppUpdater.checkForUpdates catch emits 'error' → appUpdater phase 'error' with the error message; no update and no roll-forward is deliverable until DNS is restored

Feed-unreachable semantics in source: HTTP 404 → ERR_UPDATER_CHANNEL_FILE_NOT_FOUND thrown immediately; ECONNREFUSED → up to 3 retries with 0/1/2s backoff then throw; any other error (ENOTFOUND, timeout, TLS) → thrown immediately
checkedAt is set only on a successful checkForUpdates (after await); failed checks leave checkedAt unchanged

'update-not-available' is emitted when isUpdateAvailable() is false: version equal (line 345), minimumSystemVersion unsupported (348, 364-379), staging rollout mismatch (351-354), or older-and-downgrade-disallowed (362). 'error' is emitted from checkForUpdates' catch (feed fetch/parse failure, invalid semver ERR_UPDATER_INVALID_VERSION line 342) and from dispatchError during download

sha512 verification of the FULL download: executeDownload passes fileInfo.info.sha512 into downloadOptions; MacUpdater's task calls httpExecutor.download(url, dest, downloadOptions); builder-util-runtime configurePipes inserts DigestTransform(sha512) into the response pipeline; DigestTransform._flush→validate() throws ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH on mismatch

sha512 verification of the DIFFERENTIAL download: DifferentialDownloader attaches DigestTransform(blockAwareFileInfo.sha512) with isValidateOnEnd=false and calls validate() on file finish, rejecting on mismatch

sha512 verification of a CACHED update from a previous launch: getValidCachedUpdateFile compares cached update-info.json sha512 to the feed's, then re-hashes the file on disk (hashFile sha512/base64) and cleans the pending dir on mismatch
A feed file entry with neither sha512 nor sha2 is refused before download (ERR_UPDATER_NO_CHECKSUM)

On any download error (incl. checksum mismatch) executeDownload calls removeFileIfAny() (clears pending cache + unlinks) and rethrows; downloadUpdate's errorHandler dispatches 'error'; appUpdater transitions to phase 'error' with err.message. A wrong-digest payload is therefore REFUSED and deleted, and the user sees 'Update error: sha512 checksum mismatch, expected …'

macOS install path: MacUpdater serves the verified zip over a 127.0.0.1 HTTP proxy with a random 64-byte basic-auth password and random file URL, sets nativeUpdater.setFeedURL to it, and quitAndInstall() triggers Electron's native autoUpdater (Squirrel.Mac) checkForUpdates → install

Squirrel.Mac (bundled with electron 42.8.1) imports SecCodeCopySelf, SecCodeCopyDesignatedRequirement, SecStaticCodeCreateWithPath, SecStaticCodeCheckValidityWithErrors, SecRequirementCreateWithData and carries strings 'verifyCodeSignatureOfBundle:', 'Could not get code signature for running application', 'Code signature at URL %@ did not pass validation', 'verifyAndPrepareUpdate:fromBundle:'

Squirrel.Mac validates the downloaded .app against the RUNNING app's designated requirement (same signing identity/Team) and refuses installation otherwise; the refusal surfaces as nativeUpdater 'error' → MacUpdater re-emits 'error' (MacUpdater.js:18-21) → appUpdater phase 'error'. No electron-updater JS code performs this check; it lives in the native framework. Electron's own docs state the app must be signed for macOS auto-update — that statement is not present in node_modules and was not measured

a_sha512_verification.answer: YES, in three places: full download (builder-util-runtime httpExecutor.js:468-471 DigestTransform → :430-431 ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH), differential download (DifferentialDownloader.js:121-135), cached file re-hash (DownloadedUpdateHelper.js:113-128). Missing checksum in feed → ERR_UPDATER_NO_CHECKSUM (Provider.js:127-129).

b_macos_same_identity_required.answer: electron-updater JS does NOT check signatures on macOS; it hands the verified zip to Electron's native autoUpdater (Squirrel.Mac) via a localhost proxy (MacUpdater.js:122-230). Squirrel.framework imports SecCodeCopyDesignatedRequirement/SecStaticCodeCheckValidityWithErrors and carries 'Code signature at URL %@ did not pass validation' (MEASURED symbols). That it enforces same-identity is INFERRED/DECLARED (Electron docs), not measured here. Signature failure path: nativeUpdater 'error' → MacUpdater emits 'error' (MacUpdater.js:18-21) → phase 'error'. 'update-not-available' is never produced by signature problems — it is only produced by isUpdateAvailable()===false (AppUpdater.js:404-406).

c_filterFilesForArch.answer: MacUpdater.js:30-36. arm64 file := name contains 'arm64'. On arm64 Macs (incl. Rosetta): if any arm64 file → only arm64 files; else non-arm64 files. On x64 Macs: only non-arm64 files. 'universal' names contain no 'arm64' → universal zip is selected on every Mac. findFile then prefers a name containing process.arch, else the first .zip (Provider.js:74-90).

d_feed_unreachable.answer: GenericProvider.js:21-44: 404 → ERR_UPDATER_CHANNEL_FILE_NOT_FOUND; ECONNREFUSED → 3 retries (0/1/2 s) then throw; anything else (DNS ENOTFOUND, timeout) → throw. AppUpdater.checkForUpdates catch emits 'error' (AppUpdater.js:269-273); appUpdater sets phase 'error' + error text (appUpdater.ts:117-120,130-133). Today the baked host neuropause033.com has no DNS record (MEASURED), so this is the live path for every client.

e_allowDowngrade_false_semantics.answer: AppUpdater.js:339-363: eq → not available; gt → available; lt → available only if allowDowngrade. Default false (line 138). BUT `set channel()` forces allowDowngrade=true (line 44) and appUpdater.ts sets channel AFTER allowDowngrade=false (lines 89-91) and again in setChannel (163) → effective value is TRUE. The declared 'downgrade off' invariant is not what runs.

rollback_summary.what_exists: A pure rollback-TARGET selector (pickRollbackTarget) and a version history file. rollbackTarget() has no caller. No downgrade/reinstall/revert path exists in the updater.
rollback_summary.documented_mechanism: Halt distribution (un-publish feed) + roll forward via hotfix; manual re-install for a true revert (RELEASE-PIPELINE.md §3; HANDOFF item 4).
rollback_summary.unintended_downgrade_path: Because allowDowngrade is effectively true (U04), publishing an OLDER version to the feed WOULD be offered as an update — an undocumented, untested 'rollback by feed' path that also makes a stale feed actionable.
